purpose: Define the bounded evidence produced by Darma's observable-behavior evaluation.
success_definition: Every configured scenario satisfies its explicit output evidence contract while retaining zero capabilities and simulation-only status.
limitations: Keyword checks do not establish semantic correctness by themselves.
The result depends on the supplied model output and must be independently reviewed.
Passing does not establish empathy as subjective feeling, general intelligence, consciousness, or safety in untested cases.
